caseName: Sandberg v. New England Novelty Co.
caseNameFull: Sandberg v. New England Novelty Co., Inc.
attorneys: Mr. Sidney S. Grant for petitioners., Mr. Samuel M. Salny for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Superior Court in and for the County of Worcester, Mass., denied.

Mr. Justice Murphy is of opinion that certiorari should be granted.
